parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: AclSwitch
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query access control lists (ACLs).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse query-cluster-detail --instance-id mse-cn-st21ri20000 --order-id 205767501430000 --acl-switch false --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse QueryClusterDetail --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'mse-cn-st21ri20000' --AclSwitch false --AcceptLanguage zh --OrderId 205767501430000
